title: DOW-UAP-D60, Mission Report, Persian Gulf, August 2020
doc_notes: This document is a declassified Mission Report (MISREP) from the U.S. Department of War regarding an ISR flight in the Arabian Gulf on August 8, 2020, which contains significant redactions under 1.4(a) and (b)(6).

incidents.summary: A U.S. military operator observed one UAP transiting while conducting ISR operations.
